sections.basis: IRPEF taxable income, per year (bands as published by MEF; see the special rules)
sections.note: Rates apply to each band of income.

sections.title: Special rules and legal basis (Autonomous Province of Trento)

rows.label: Special rules (disposizioni particolari)
rows.value: Taxable income up to €30,000: a deduction of €30,000 (so no surcharge); no deduction above €30,000. Income up to €50,000: €246 credit per dependent child. No refund.

rows.label: Legal basis (norme di riferimento)
rows.value: Articolo 1, commi 2 quater, 2 sexies e 3 bis, della legge provinciale 23 dicembre 2019, n. 13, come modificato dall'articolo 1 della legge provinciale 29 dicembre 2025, n. 11.
